# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256: 57943d05bd0242ca4a061d10c50291b8d30ef93f1f833e4da66704b400815bf7.
# Account and perm identifiers are sanitized; the two connection legs preserve
# the live paper Gateway behavior observed on 2026-07-04 (outside regular
# trading hours, order rests PreSubmitted): on reconnect with the same client
# ID the Gateway pushes an unsolicited open-orders snapshot immediately after
# START_API, the req_open_orders recovery snapshot pairs each open_order with
# an order_status, and cancelling the recovered order by ID yields an
# order_status Cancelled with no live OrderHandle in the process
# (https://github.com/ThomasMarcelis/ibkr-go/issues/20).
